result.title: Bearing wear
result.text: Sustained vibration rise above 3 sigma together with rising bearing temperature indicates bearing wear. Inspect the bearing within 72 h and take an oil sample.

result.title: Misalignment
result.text: Vibration rise without a matching bearing temperature rise may indicate misalignment. Confirm with a frequency spectrum (1x/2x running speed).

rule: alert active; above alarm=False; RUL<=100h=True -> high

args.actions: Inspect the bearing and take an oil sample within 72 h; monitor vibration and temperature continuously; stop the machine if vibration reaches 7.0 mm/s.
args.evidence: Vibration 3.68 mm/s (+105.9% vs. baseline 1.79), 48 h above 3 sigma, bearing temperature 55.7 -> 64.9 °C, estimated remaining life about 38 h.
